name: Mother In Law
overview: Scripture addresses the relationship with a mother-in-law both in terms of moral boundaries and faithful devotion. Leviticus and Deuteronomy sternly prohibit illicit relations with a mother-in-law, emphasizing the holiness required in family connections and warning against defilement. Conversely, the book of Ruth highlights a positive example of love and loyalty, where Ruth clings steadfastly to her mother-in-law Naomi, embracing her people and God. These passages collectively teach the importance of honoring family roles with purity and commitment under God's standards.
